description: Drinking water advisory reporting system (DWARS) is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Health. DWARS is a web-based data management system for local boards of health (BOH) to report information pertaining to the issuance of drinking water advisory notices or orders and details about corrective actions (and rescinded advisory notices). Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Health. Its tags are Health, Health and wellness, Santé, Santé et bien-être. The portal shows 2021-01-14 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
